description: This file defines authentication-related API routes for user registration, login, and admin login in a FastAPI application. It includes route handlers that perform user creation, authentication, and token generation, utilizing security utilities and database interactions.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response containing an access token and user details.

classes.name: AdminLogin
classes.description: Schema for admin login payload containing username and password.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new user, including name, email, and password.

classes.name: UserLogin
classes.description: Schema for user login payload including email and password.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Schema representing public user data sent in responses.

methods.name: TokenResponse register(payload: UserCreate)
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating user, hashing password, and returning a token.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: UserLogin)
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying credentials and issuing a token.

methods.name: TokenResponse admin_login(payload: AdminLogin)
methods.description: Handles admin login using environment-based credentials and issues a token.
